LanguageData.LP_FireGiantCore.label: molten giant origin
LanguageData.LP_FireGiantCore.description: The molten-fire bloodline of fire giants, inherited with the race. The robust build and deep red skin come from the Biotech vanilla appearance genes. Adults are 2.0 times the size of an ordinary person (the bloodline body size cap); the bigger the body, the stronger the health and melee (see giant-body rules: adult total health ×150%, melee damage ×130%), and slow. Completely immune to fire damage and can't be ignited. When crafting with the Crafting skill, there is a 50% chance to raise quality by one tier (up to masterwork). Fire giants are never sad about being naked. Ordinary clothes scale up with the giant body.
LanguageData.LP_FireGiantCore.customEffectDescription: The robust build and deep red skin come from vanilla appearance genes.
Body size grows with age, reaching the max multiplier ×2.0 as an adult.
Giant-body rules: the bigger the body, the stronger the health and melee. Adult total health ×150%, melee damage ×130% (adjustable in mod settings; health is still ×150% when off).
Giant stomach: max food rises with body size, ×200% as an adult (children grow with age); hunger rate unchanged, so one meal lasts longer.
Completely immune to fire damage, can't be ignited.
Crafted items have a 50% chance of +1 quality tier (up to masterwork).
Giant lineage: fire giant (rank 3 of the ordning, above frost giants). Can wear ordinary clothes; giant-only apparel can only be worn by giants, each piece mood +2 (up to +6).
